note: Triennial election of the Strabane rural district councillors, 1927. Nominations were received by Mr. W. H. Ingram, deputy returning officer (Strabane Chronicle, 23 April 1927, p. 1). Ballyfatton was the only double nomination and Capt. J. C. Herdman withdrew, so there was no contest (Ulster Herald, 30 April 1927, p. 5). In Glenmornan, Loughash, Cranagh and Speerin no nominations were received and the named retiring councillors were deemed re-elected. No poll was held; Tyrone's polling day was 1 June 1927. Returned unopposed.
